title: Vizermon
description: Explore, survive, and catch ’em all in a true vanilla-plus world.
body:
🐺 Vizermon – Pokémon Meets Classic Survival

Vizermon is a carefully crafted modpack that blends Cobblemon with classic Minecraft survival and exploration.
The goal is simple: keep the vanilla feel while expanding the adventure with new dimensions, challenges, and discoveries.

🌍 Features

New Dimension: Travel to the Aether, now with full Pokémon spawns.

Vanilla Survival Rules:

❌ No Keep Inventory → death has weight.

❌ No Teleportation → rely on real travel.

❌ No Veinmining → enchantments like Efficiency matter again.

Mobs Enabled by Default: Play with both Pokémon and hostile mobs for a true survival challenge. Prefer peaceful? Mobs can be toggled off.

🌟 Future Plans

More Pokémon-supported dimensions & biomes.

Dungeon and loot tweaks for better progression.

Subtle QoL features that don’t break balance.

Immersion upgrades like new sounds & music.

Ongoing multiplayer performance improvements.

🎮 Vision

Vizermon is built for players who love authentic survival gameplay, but want it enriched with Pokémon, new worlds to explore, and natural-feeling challenges.
No shortcuts, no cheats—just adventure, exploration, and progression the way Minecraft was meant to be played.

⚔️ Adventure awaits—will you rise to the challenge in Vizermon?
